# TwitterShots

TwitterShots renders public X posts as screenshots and retrieves tweet content and API usage.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/twittershots/.

## Actions

- **Generate Temporary Screenshot URL**: Render a public tweet or post and return a provider-hosted temporary URL.
- **Generate Tweet Screenshot**: Render a public tweet or post as an SVG, PNG, or HTML file suitable for saving.
- **Get API Usage** (read-only): Return the remaining and total TwitterShots API credits for the connected API key.
- **Get Bulk Tweet Content** (read-only): Fetch up to 100 public tweets as one Markdown document.
- **Get Tweet Content** (read-only): Fetch one public tweet as structured Markdown, with optional statistics, media links, and quoted-tweet content.
